name: yukibana-pack-rust
description: Yukibana Rust pack: rust-analyzer's IDE crates compiled to wasm32-wasip1 in a module Web Worker, and a runner on rustc and Miri compiled to WebAssembly (rustc/build.sh), with LLVM for WebAssembly, x86-64, AArch64 and RISC-V. build.sh assembles the pack; this file holds the bundler, the WASI file system the runner uses, and the test's browser driver.
